parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is a rotation lid of a cardboard box, made of cardboard material with moderate stiffness and flexibility.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a flap that can be rotated to open or close the box, protecting the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the edge of the box base, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the cardboard box, made of the same cardboard material.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other lid to fully close the box and secure its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line to cover or uncover the box opening.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the cardboard box, forming the main structure that holds items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage space and structural support for the box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the foundation for the rotating lids.
